metadata.author: Jaden Cole
metadata.title: Dental Release Plan Revision
metadata.demo_effect: Documents the delivery impact of the delay and how scope is reshaped around critical path work.

payload.summary: The Dental Release Plan has been revised due to a critical-path disruption caused by a vendor sandbox issue. The plan now includes mitigation strategies based on whether the vendor path recovers by 4/15 or not.

decisions.label: Defer non-critical feature stories
decisions.anchorText: Non-critical feature stories originally slated for Sprint 2

decisions.label: Defer polished demo scripting
decisions.anchorText: Polished demo scripting that assumes full environment readiness

decisions.label: Defer some stakeholder-facing refinements
decisions.anchorText: Some stakeholder-facing refinements that do not reduce actual readiness risk

warnings: The vendor sandbox issue is a critical-path disruption that now governs what can be credibly promised in PI 4.
If the vendor path does not recover, the product will continue to be reported as at risk until the evidence posture materially improves.
